in_sanskrit.name: रविन्द्रसिंह
in_sanskrit.meaning: रवि (Ravi) - One who delights in the sight of Lord Vishnu, दन्द (Sinh) - Lion, सिंह (Sinh) - A name given to a king or a ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who delights in the sight of Lord Vishnu (Ravi) and is a lion (Sinh) or a king.

in_hindi.name: रविन्द्रसिंह
in_hindi.meaning: रवि (Ravi) - विष्वक्सेन (Vishnu) का अनुभवी, सिंह (Sinh) - सिंह (Lion) या राजा (King)
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who embodies the experiences of Lord Vishnu (Ravi) and is a lion (Sinh) or a king.

in_marathi.name: Ravindrasinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ravindrasinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ravindra means 'Lord of the Sun' and Sinh means 'Lion'. Thus, Ravindrasinh means 'Lord of the Sun, Lion-borne'.

in_bengali.name: Ravindrasinh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Sun
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ravindrasinh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ravindra means 'Lord of the Sun' and Sinh means 'Lion'. Thus, Ravindrasinh means 'Lord of the Sun, Lion-borne'.
